_note: Limits verified against each provider's own docs on 2026-11-08 (NVIDIA: no official table, community-verified). gemini and zai added 2026-11-22 from their docs. Model ids verified the same day except NVIDIA's (catalog unreachable); `pocket doctor` warns after 30 days. pocket trusts live 429s over these numbers. A copy in your config dir overrides this file. price_per_mtok values are placeholders used only to enforce daily_cap_usd; set your real prices.

groq.label: Groq
groq.source: https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (table is labelled Developer-plan base limits; your console may show lower)

cerebras.label: Cerebras
cerebras.setup_note: 1M tokens a day, 5 requests a minute

nvidia.label: NVIDIA
nvidia.setup_note: about 40 requests a minute; phone verification
nvidia.source: model ids from https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models on 2026-11-14 (meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct was retired, 410); ~40 rpm is community-verified, NVIDIA publishes no table

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.setup_note: 50 requests a day on free models
openrouter.source: openrouter/free routes to a currently free model with the needed features, so retired :free ids don't break pocket. 50 rpd; 1,000 rpd after $10 lifetime credit purchase: raise rpd in your override. https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/reference/limits

mistral.label: Mistral
mistral.notice: Requests on Mistral's free Experiment plan may be used to train Mistral's models. Not in the default order; add it to pocket.yml yourself if that is acceptable.

gemini.label: Google Gemini
gemini.setup_note: free quota per model; see AI Studio
gemini.source: OpenAI-compatible endpoint: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai. Free-tier limits are per model and shown only in Google AI Studio (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits); models with no free quota answer 429 'limit: 0' and pocket drops them for 24h.
gemini.notice: On the free tier Google may use your prompts and code to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them (outside the EEA, Switzerland and the UK). https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms. Not in the default order; add it if that is acceptable.

zai.label: Z.ai (GLM)
zai.source: GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash are free per https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing.md; base URL from https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/quick-start.md. Rate limits are not published outside the Z.ai console.
zai.notice: pocket has not verified how Z.ai (Zhipu) handles data sent to its free models. Not in the default order; add it if that is acceptable.

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.setup_note: paid; used first, up to the daily cap
anthropic.source: paid; capped by daily_cap_usd in pocket.yml

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.source: paid; capped by daily_cap_usd in pocket.yml
